function.name: summarize_cvecpes
function.description: Summarize a list of CVE/CPE items, providing various statistics and information about the items. The function processes both CPE and CVE items, identified by the presence of 'cpeName' or 'cveId' respectively. For CPE items, it extracts vendor and product type information from the CPE name. For CVE items, it counts unique CVE IDs and summarizes severity levels. The function tracks the earliest and latest modification dates across all items. If the input list is empty, it returns a simple 'No items to summarize.' message. The returned string is formatted with multiple lines and sections for readability. Date strings in the input are expected to be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The function uses Python's datetime and Counter classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

lastModified.description: Last modification date of the CPE item.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity of the CVE.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modification date of the CVE item.

cvecpeList.description: List of CVE/CPE objects to be summarized.

returns.description: A formatted string containing a summary of the input CVE/CPE list, including total items, unique vendors, product types, CVE counts, severity distribution, and modification date range.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_end
function.description: Verify and process the end date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days after the start date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original end date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days after the start date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed end date, either the original end date if within 90 days of the start date, or a date 90 days after the start date.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_start
function.description: Verify and process the start date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days before the end date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original start date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days before the end date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed start date, either the original start date if within 90 days of the end date, or a date 90 days before the end date.

function.name: searchCPE
function.description: Search for CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) entries based on various criteria. All parameters are optional. If not provided, they won't be used in filtering. Date parameters should be provided in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The function uses case-insensitive matching for string comparisons where applicable, except when keywordExactMatch is true. Date range filtering is only applied if both start and end dates are provided. The function searches through a predefined CPE_DB. In a real implementation, this function would interact with the NVD (National Vulnerability Database) API. The 'verbose' parameter, if set to true, would print a GET request URL, simulating an API call. The actual implementation may include more fields in the returned CPE objects than those specified in the 'returns' schema.

cpeNameId.description: Specific CPE Name ID to search for.

cpeMatchString.description: Partial CPE name to match against.

keywordExactMatch.description: If true, perform an exact match on the keyword.

keywordSearch.description: Keyword to search in CPE titles.

lastModStartDate.description: Start date for last modification filter (YYYY-MM-DD).

lastModEndDate.description: End date for last modification filter (YYYY-MM-DD).

matchCriteriaId.description: Specific match criteria ID to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

key.description: API key for authentication (not used in this mock version).

delay.description: Delay between API requests in seconds (not used in this mock version).

verbose.description: If true, print the request URL.

cpeNameId.description: The CPE Name ID.

cpeName.description: The full CPE name.

titles.description: List of titles associated with the CPE.

lastModified.description: Date of last modification.

matchCriteria.description: List of match criteria associated with the CPE.

returns.description: A list of CPE objects matching the search criteria.

function.name: searchCVE
function.description: Search for CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) entries based on various criteria. All parameters are optional. If not provided, they won't be used in filtering. Date parameters should be provided in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The function uses case-insensitive matching for string comparisons where applicable. Date range filtering is only applied if both start and end dates are provided. The function searches through a predefined CVE_DB, which is not represented in this schema. Additional keyword arguments (**kwargs) are accepted but not used in the current implementation. The actual implementation may include more fields in the returned CVE objects than those specified in the 'returns' schema.

function.name: search_backup_keywords
function.description: Search using backup keywords if the initial search returns no results. If the initial cvecpeList is empty, the function will perform a backup search. The backup search uses either searchCVE or searchCPE based on the backup_keyword. If 'cve' is in the backup_keyword (case-insensitive), searchCVE is used; otherwise, searchCPE is used. The searchCVE and searchCPE functions are not defined in this schema and may need separate representations.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

returns.description: Either the initial results or results from the backup search.

function.name: summarize_cvecpes
function.description: Summarize a list of CVE/CPE items, providing various statistics and information about the items. The function processes both CPE and CVE items, identified by the presence of 'cpeName' or 'cveId' respectively. For CPE items, it extracts vendor and product type information from the CPE name. For CVE items, it counts unique CVE IDs and summarizes severity levels. The function tracks the earliest and latest modification dates across all items. If the input list is empty, it returns a simple 'No items to summarize.' message. The returned string is formatted with multiple lines and sections for readability. Date strings in the input are expected to be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The function uses Python's datetime and Counter classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

lastModified.description: Last modification date of the CPE item.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity of the CVE.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modification date of the CVE item.

cvecpeList.description: List of CVE/CPE objects to be summarized.

returns.description: A formatted string containing a summary of the input CVE/CPE list, including total items, unique vendors, product types, CVE counts, severity distribution, and modification date range.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_end
function.description: Verify and process the end date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days after the start date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original end date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days after the start date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed end date, either the original end date if within 90 days of the start date, or a date 90 days after the start date.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_start
function.description: Verify and process the start date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days before the end date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original start date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days before the end date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed start date, either the original start date if within 90 days of the end date, or a date 90 days before the end date.

Date parameters should be provided in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The function uses case-insensitive matching for string comparisons where applicable, except when keywordExactMatch is true. Date range filtering is only applied if both start and end dates are provided. The function searches through a predefined CPE_DB. In a real implementation, this function would interact with the NVD (National Vulnerability Database) API. The 'verbose' parameter, if set to true, would print a GET request URL, simulating an API call. The actual implementation may include more fields in the returned CPE objects than those specified in the 'returns' schema.

cpeNameId.description: Specific CPE Name ID to search for.

cpeMatchString.description: Partial CPE name to match against.

keywordExactMatch.description: If true, perform an exact match on the keyword.

keywordSearch.description: Keyword to search in CPE titles.

lastModStartDate.description: Start date for last modification filter (YYYY-MM-DD).

lastModEndDate.description: End date for last modification filter (YYYY-MM-DD).

matchCriteriaId.description: Specific match criteria ID to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

key.description: API key for authentication (not used in this mock version).

delay.description: Delay between API requests in seconds (not used in this mock version).

verbose.description: If true, print the request URL.

cpeNameId.description: The CPE Name ID.

cpeName.description: The full CPE name.

titles.description: List of titles associated with the CPE.

lastModified.description: Date of last modification.

matchCriteria.description: List of match criteria associated with the CPE.

returns.description: A list of CPE objects matching the search criteria.

function.name: searchCVE
function.description: Search for CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) entries based on various criteria. All parameters are optional. If not provided, they won't be used in filtering. Date parameters should be provided in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The function uses case-insensitive matching for string comparisons where applicable. Date range filtering is only applied if both start and end dates are provided. The function searches through a predefined CVE_DB, which is not represented in this schema. Additional keyword arguments (**kwargs) are accepted but not used in the current implementation. The actual implementation may include more fields in the returned CVE objects than those specified in the 'returns' schema.

keywordSearch.description: Keyword to search for in CVE descriptions.

cvssV2Severity.description: CVSS V2 severity level to filter by.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity level to filter by.

cveId.description: Specific CVE ID to search for.

lastModStartDate.description: Start date for last modification date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

lastModEndDate.description: End date for last modification date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

pubStartDate.description: Start date for publication date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

pubEndDate.description: End date for publication date range (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cvssV2Metrics.description: CVSS V2 metrics string to filter by.

hasCertAlerts.description: Filter for CVEs with CERT alerts.

hasOval.description: Filter for CVEs with OVAL definitions.

hasCertNotes.description: Filter for CVEs with CERT notes.

cpeName.description: CPE name to filter affected products.

key.description: API key for authentication (if required).

cveId.description: The CVE identifier.

cvssV2Severity.description: CVSS V2 severity of the vulnerability.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity of the vulnerability.

lastModifiedDate.description: Date of last modification.

returns.description: A list of CVE objects matching the search criteria.

function.name: search_backup_keywords
function.description: Search using backup keywords if the initial search returns no results. If the initial cvecpeList is empty, the function will perform a backup search. The backup search uses either searchCVE or searchCPE based on the backup_keyword. If 'cve' is in the backup_keyword (case-insensitive), searchCVE is used; otherwise, searchCPE is used. The searchCVE and searchCPE functions are not defined in this schema and may need separate representations.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

cvecpeList.description: The initial search results.

backup_keyword.description: The backup keyword to use if initial results are empty.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

returns.description: Either the initial results or results from the backup search.

function.name: summarize_cvecpes
function.description: Summarize a list of CVE/CPE items, providing various statistics and information about the items. The function processes both CPE and CVE items, identified by the presence of 'cpeName' or 'cveId' respectively. For CPE items, it extracts vendor and product type information from the CPE name. For CVE items, it counts unique CVE IDs and summarizes severity levels. The function tracks the earliest and latest modification dates across all items. If the input list is empty, it returns a simple 'No items to summarize.' message. The returned string is formatted with multiple lines and sections for readability. Date strings in the input are expected to be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The function uses Python's datetime and Counter classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

lastModified.description: Last modification date of the CPE item.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity of the CVE.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modification date of the CVE item.

cvecpeList.description: List of CVE/CPE objects to be summarized.

returns.description: A formatted string containing a summary of the input CVE/CPE list, including total items, unique vendors, product types, CVE counts, severity distribution, and modification date range.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_end
function.description: Verify and process the end date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days after the start date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original end date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days after the start date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed end date, either the original end date if within 90 days of the start date, or a date 90 days after the start date.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_start
function.description: Verify and process the start date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days before the end date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original start date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days before the end date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed start date, either the original start date if within 90 days of the end date, or a date 90 days before the end date.

function.name: summarize_cvecpes
function.description: Summarize a list of CVE/CPE items, providing various statistics and information about the items. The function processes both CPE and CVE items, identified by the presence of 'cpeName' or 'cveId' respectively. For CPE items, it extracts vendor and product type information from the CPE name. For CVE items, it counts unique CVE IDs and summarizes severity levels. The function tracks the earliest and latest modification dates across all items. If the input list is empty, it returns a simple 'No items to summarize.' message. The returned string is formatted with multiple lines and sections for readability. Date strings in the input are expected to be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The function uses Python's datetime and Counter classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

lastModified.description: Last modification date of the CPE item.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity of the CVE.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modification date of the CVE item.

cvecpeList.description: List of CVE/CPE objects to be summarized.

returns.description: A formatted string containing a summary of the input CVE/CPE list, including total items, unique vendors, product types, CVE counts, severity distribution, and modification date range.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_end
function.description: Verify and process the end date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days after the start date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original end date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days after the start date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed end date, either the original end date if within 90 days of the start date, or a date 90 days after the start date.

function.name: summarize_cvecpes
function.description: Summarize a list of CVE/CPE items, providing various statistics and information about the items. The function processes both CPE and CVE items, identified by the presence of 'cpeName' or 'cveId' respectively. For CPE items, it extracts vendor and product type information from the CPE name. For CVE items, it counts unique CVE IDs and summarizes severity levels. The function tracks the earliest and latest modification dates across all items. If the input list is empty, it returns a simple 'No items to summarize.' message. The returned string is formatted with multiple lines and sections for readability. Date strings in the input are expected to be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The function uses Python's datetime and Counter classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

lastModified.description: Last modification date of the CPE item.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity of the CVE.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modification date of the CVE item.

cvecpeList.description: List of CVE/CPE objects to be summarized.

returns.description: A formatted string containing a summary of the input CVE/CPE list, including total items, unique vendors, product types, CVE counts, severity distribution, and modification date range.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_end
function.description: Verify and process the end date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days after the start date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original end date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days after the start date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed end date, either the original end date if within 90 days of the start date, or a date 90 days after the start date.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_start
function.description: Verify and process the start date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days before the end date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original start date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days before the end date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed start date, either the original start date if within 90 days of the end date, or a date 90 days before the end date.

function.name: searchCPE
function.description: Search for CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) entries based on various criteria. All parameters are optional. If not provided, they won't be used in filtering. Date parameters should be provided in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The function uses case-insensitive matching for string comparisons where applicable, except when keywordExactMatch is true. Date range filtering is only applied if both start and end dates are provided. The function searches through a predefined CPE_DB. matchCriteria.description: List of match criteria associated with the CPE.

returns.description: A list of CPE objects matching the search criteria.

function.name: summarize_cvecpes
function.description: Summarize a list of CVE/CPE items, providing various statistics and information about the items. The function processes both CPE and CVE items, identified by the presence of 'cpeName' or 'cveId' respectively. For CPE items, it extracts vendor and product type information from the CPE name. For CVE items, it counts unique CVE IDs and summarizes severity levels. The function tracks the earliest and latest modification dates across all items. If the input list is empty, it returns a simple 'No items to summarize.' message. The returned string is formatted with multiple lines and sections for readability. Date strings in the input are expected to be in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). The function uses Python's datetime and Counter classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

cpeName.description: Unique identifier for a CPE object.

lastModified.description: Last modification date of the CPE item.

cveId.description: Unique identifier for a CVE object.

cvssV3Severity.description: CVSS V3 severity of the CVE.

lastModifiedDate.description: Last modification date of the CVE item.

cvecpeList.description: List of CVE/CPE objects to be summarized.

returns.description: A formatted string containing a summary of the input CVE/CPE list, including total items, unique vendors, product types, CVE counts, severity distribution, and modification date range.

function.name: verify_and_process_data_range_end
function.description: Verify and process the end date of a date range, ensuring it's not more than 90 days after the start date. The function expects dates in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. If the difference between start and end dates is 90 days or less, the original end date is returned. If the difference is more than 90 days, a new date 90 days after the start date is returned. The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

returns.description: The processed end date, either the original end date if within 90 days of the start date, or a date 90 days after the start date.

The function uses Python's datetime and timedelta classes, which are not directly representable in JSON schema.

startdate.description: The start date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enddate.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.
